globalRules: These are new side-view fighting-game adaptations, not frame-perfect copies of any source game.
Actor attacks toward screen right, but chest/hips MUST rotate through front-three-quarter and back-three-quarter views. Do not force all 8 drawings into the same side silhouette.
At least 3 clearly different blade orientations and two visibly different torso orientations per cutting move. The tip must sweep an arc, not remain aimed forward while the arm extends.
Eight individually drawn poses: load, counter-rotate, drive, accelerate, contact, pass-through, decelerate, recover. Timing is not uniform.
Plant a pivot foot; heel and pelvis lead the shoulders, wrists trail the body, cloth/hair trail the wrists. Keep anatomy coherent.
FX are secondary: body and blade motion must read with all FX hidden. Thin blade-attached trails only in asset art; runtime trails follow the blade arc, not a straight generic beam.
Preserve full weapon and feet with generous transparent gutters. No changing weapon length to fit the panel.
